One named owner on the OnlyFans/page line whose weekly job is to confirm every pinned drop in-chat with a result, acknowledge every content handover within a day, and re-ask her for the next release dates before the calendar runs out — plus a day-14 onboarding close-out so the chatter FAQ form, the kickoff call and the impersonator takedown cannot still be open at day 39. Billing, promo and DMCA all produced something this month; the thing she actually pays for produced no messages, no drop coverage and no customs answer for fifteen days, while she kept handing us more revenue with nobody on the other side to catch it.
